stories.title: A cheque outstanding at the year end clears in January
stories.recipe: a cheque written on 30 December is presented on 5 January, across the year end

stories.title: A deposit in transit across the end of January
stories.recipe: a receipt recorded on 31 January reaches the bank on 1 February; both statements run to two pages

stories.title: Interest credited on the last day of February, booked in March
stories.recipe: the bank credits interest on 28 February, the last day of a 28-day month; the company books it on 2 March

stories.title: A chain over the year end: a November cheque presented in January
stories.recipe: a cheque written on 27 November is not presented in December and is presented on 12 January; the December session is in the roll format and holds the November session

stories.title: Two carried payments: one by reference, one by amount
stories.recipe: a referenced cheque and an unreferenced payment are outstanding in December; January shows both

stories.title: A carried cheque paid for another amount
stories.recipe: the cheque was written for 3,481.00 and the bank paid 3,418.00, two digits transposed

stories.title: A carried payment re-entered under a new voucher
stories.recipe: the February cashbook carries the January payment again under a new voucher, same reference, date and amount; the February statement pays it

stories.title: A carried bank charge charged again in January
stories.recipe: the bank charges the quarterly fee on 31 December and again on 3 January under the same reference; the company books it once, on 3 January

stories.title: A carried cheque paid twice
stories.recipe: the bank pays the carried cheque twice, on 5 and 9 January

stories.title: An unreferenced carried payment with two candidates
stories.recipe: an unreferenced February payment; March shows two unreferenced withdrawals of the same amount

stories.title: A previous session that skips February
stories.recipe: the January session is brought to the March statement; February is missing

stories.title: A previous session of another currency
stories.recipe: the December session is the dollar account; January is the riyal account

stories.title: An opening balance one riyal off the previous closing
stories.recipe: January's printed opening balance is one riyal below December's printed closing balance

stories.title: The previous period has an undecided suggestion
stories.recipe: December leaves an amount and date suggestion undecided

stories.title: The previous statement misses a page
stories.recipe: the December statement in the session is pages 1 and 3 of 3; page 2 was never printed

stories.title: A session of a version the product does not know
stories.recipe: the session file declares version bank-statement-lifecycle-2, which the product does not read

stories.title: A rejected suggestion carries both members; one clears

decisions.note: Standing order to the landlord, not the contractor advance

stories.recipe: December: an unreferenced debit and an unreferenced payment of the same amount a day apart, rejected by the accountant; January pays the advance as an unreferenced counter cheque

stories.title: Arabic, Arabic-Indic digits: a carried cheque presented
stories.recipe: an Arabic statement with Arabic-Indic digits: a December cheque presented in January

stories.title: Arabic, Latin digits: an equal amount under another reference
stories.recipe: an Arabic statement with Latin digits: January pays another cheque of the same amount; the carried one waits

stories.title: No previous session
stories.recipe: January alone; the cheque written in December has no counterpart there

stories.title: An accepted suggestion is not carried; a cheque is

decisions.note: Counter receipt deposited the day before

stories.recipe: December: an accepted amount and date suggestion and an outstanding cheque; January presents the cheque

stories.title: A chain whose own previous period was refused
stories.recipe: the December session is in the roll format and holds a November session of the dollar account: December could not carry November, so January cannot read December as closed
